name: application-progress-ring-cluster
title: Progress Ring Cluster
description: Grouped radial progress dials with center percentage labels for showing several related metrics (CPU, memory, disk, etc.) at a glance on a multi-metric dashboard.
useWhen: Showing several related percentage metrics side by side in a compact, glanceable form.
A radial dial communicates "fullness" more intuitively than a linear bar for the specific metric (e.g. resource usage).
Each metric needs its own color and center label rather than being stacked in one chart.
avoidWhen: You only have one metric — a single progress-bars or a stat-tile is simpler.
Precise comparison between values matters more than at-a-glance shape — a bar chart or table communicates exact differences better.
The values change very frequently — smooth realtime radial animation needs extra work beyond this static-render component.
responsiveBehavior: Rings wrap onto multiple lines within the flex container as space runs out; each ring is a fixed pixel size (default 96px) via the `size` prop.
accessibility: Each filled ring circle carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the metric name and percentage, since arc angle alone isn't announced by screen readers.
The percentage is also rendered as visible text in the center of each ring, not conveyed by the arc alone.
Values are clamped to 0–100 before being used to compute the stroke-dasharray offset.

variants.title: Progress ring cluster
variants.description: Three radial dials (CPU 72%, Memory 45%, Disk 88%) with distinct colors and center labels, on a light surface.
accessibility: Ring color is supplementary; the center percentage text and aria-label carry the precise value.

variants.title: Progress ring cluster (Dark)
variants.description: Three radial dials with the same metrics, adapted for dark surfaces with lightened ring colors for contrast.
accessibility: Ring and track colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
